title: AiRouter Log Entry
description: Schema for a single line in the AiRouter JSONL request/response log (requests.jsonl). Each transaction produces TWO lines that share the same correlationId: a 'request' entry written when the request arrives, and a 'response' entry written when the upstream response has been fully received (or when the router fails the request).

correlationId.description: UUID v7 (time-ordered) shared by the matching 'request' and 'response' entries of one transaction.

type.description: Discriminator: which half of the transaction this entry represents.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone offset). For 'request' entries: when the request arrived. For 'response' entries: when the last byte of the response was received from upstream (or when the router emitted an error response).

model.description: [request only] Model name extracted from the original request body. Empty string if the body was malformed.

matchedRule.description: [request only] Regex pattern of the routing rule that matched. Empty string if no rule matched.

targetUrl.description: [request only] Full URL the request was forwarded to (baseUrl + /v1/messages). Empty string if no rule matched.

requestSizeBytes.description: [request only] Size of the request body in bytes (UTF-8 encoded), reflecting any ForceModel substitution already applied.

requestHeaders.description: [request only] All HTTP request headers. Authorization and x-api-key values are replaced with "[redacted]".

requestBody.description: [request only] Full text of the request body sent to the upstream (after any model substitution).

statusCode.description: [response only] HTTP status code returned to the client (upstream status, or 4xx/5xx generated by the router for early failures).

durationMs.description: [response only] Elapsed time in milliseconds between request arrival and the moment the response entry was emitted.

responseSizeBytes.description: [response only] Size of the response body in bytes (UTF-8 encoded). For SSE streams this is the total accumulated size.

responseHeaders.description: [response only] All HTTP response headers (message headers + content headers).

responseBody.description: [response only] Stringified JSON envelope wrapping the upstream payload(s) so no detail is lost. Shape: { "responses": [ ... ] }. Each entry is either { "kind": "event", "event": "<name>", "data": <parsed-json-or-string> } for SSE events (one entry per event, in order) or { "kind": "response", "contentType": "<mime>", "body": <parsed-json-or-string> } for a single non-streamed response. The dashboard is responsible for replaying SSE entries to reconstruct the full assistant message and any tool_use requests.
